class.name: GDGameLights
class.description: This node allows for the utilization of the OpenRGB SDK to control supported lights. If offers some basic functions to modify the state of the lights.
class.tutorials: Demo code is available at the official github repo.

method.name: connect_to_openrgb
method.description: Connect to the openrgb server sdk. The [param host] and [param port] parameters must be the same as the [b]host[/b] and [b]port[/b] on the OpenRGB app.

method.name: disconnect
method.description: Disconnect from the OpenRGB server. This function is automatically called when the destructor for [GDGameLights] is called.

method.name: set_all_devices_color
method.description: Set the color of the light of all supported devices to [param color].
